title: Shared definitions
description: Shapes every husk document kind uses: identity, links to data, byte ranges, the contract header's parts, vectors and curves.

uuid.description: A stable id: a lowercase canonical UUID, the same across re-exports and edits. Objects in arrays that can grow large carry one and are referenced by it, never by array position, since positions renumber when an array is filtered, merged or re-sorted.

identity.description: What the thing structurally is. The kind says which identity space the value belongs to; values from different kinds never compare equal.

oneOf.description: A file identified by its numeric file id.
A row of a named data table.
A position in a list the surrounding document defines.

ref.description: A reference: structural identity plus a display name whose origin is stated. The name is decoration and may be wrong; the identity is what to compare.

name.description: Display name; absent when there is none.

name_source.description: Where the name came from, present exactly when name is: embedded in the source file, a community file list, a data table, a community-maintained name table outside the client (community), or made up by the exporter.

asset_ref.description: A reference to another document, with a uri when that document was exported alongside; without one the reference is known but unresolved.

name.description: Display name; absent when there is none.

name_source.description: Where the name came from, present exactly when name is: embedded in the source file, a community file list, a data table, a community-maintained name table outside the client (community), or made up by the exporter.

uri.description: Path of the referenced document's manifest or file, relative to this document.

payload.description: Data stored in its own file, with the media type a consumer reads it by. The format does not restrict which types are allowed: it says a face has a texture, not how the texture is stored.

uri.description: Path of the file, relative to this document.

media_type.description: IANA media type of the file's contents.

buffer_slice.description: A typed array stored as raw little-endian bytes in a binary file next to the document, byte_length always count * component_count * the component's size.

file.description: Binary file, relative to this document.

byte_offset.description: Start of the array in the file.

byte_length.description: Length of the array in bytes.

semantic.description: Well-known vertex attribute name, where the array is one.

flags.description: A bit field as stored by the source, in lowercase hex.

quat.description: Rotation quaternion x, y, z, w.

rgb.description: Colour r, g, b in 0..1 as stored, no gamma conversion.

rgba.description: Colour r, g, b, a in 0..1 as stored, no gamma conversion.

space.description: The frame every position, direction and angle in the document is expressed in.

provenance.description: Who wrote the document, from what input, and which data sources could be consulted. No export time: a document's bytes depend only on its inputs and the producer, so identical content is stored once (REFACTOR/CORPUS_EXPORT.md).

input_format.description: Name of the input format the document was decoded from; informational.

sources.description: Every data source the exporter could have asked, and whether it could. An absent value whose source was available means the subject has none; one whose source was unavailable is unknown.

name.description: What the source is, e.g. a table name or the file list.

role.description: What the exporter uses it for.

detail.description: Why it was unavailable, or where it was read from.

reference.description: Another document this one depends on, which everything that points at it names by its id.

id.description: This reference's stable id, unique among the document's references: derived from the kind and the referenced document's identity (REFACTOR/BUNDLE_FORMAT.md "Stable ids"), so a document named by file id or data-table row has the same id wherever it is referenced.

asset.description: The referenced document's identity (its subject's), and uri when exported alongside.

document.description: The referenced document itself, written inline instead of as its own file; checked like a file of its kind.

source_record.description: Which source record an entry was decoded from: the source chunk or table's name and the record's position in it.

table.description: Name of the source table or chunk.

index.description: Position of the record in that table.

sequence_kind.description: Whether a curve plays during an animation sequence or loops on a global timer.

interpolation.description: How values between keyframes are computed.

inline_curve.description: Keyframes for one sequence or global sequence: one M2Track's keys for that sequence, from the model file or the sequence's .anim sidecar.

keyframes.description: [time, value] pairs; the value is a number or an array, depending on the property.

animated.description: A property's curves, one per sequence that animates it; [] means never animated and no value.

vec3_curve.description: An inline_curve whose keyframe values are vec3s.

animated_vec3.description: A vector property's curves, one per sequence that animates it; [] means never animated and no value.

lifetime_curve.description: Keyframes over a particle's own age: [raw timestamp 0..32767 read as a fraction of the lifespan, value].

texture_entry.description: A texture reference and whether texture_resolution could resolve it: the file the source names (by FileDataID or path), looked up through the literal, listfile and fuzzy same-basename tiers (src/sources/texture_resolution.cpp).

id.description: This entry's stable id, unique in the document's texture table, derived from the texture's identity and what else tells two entries of one file apart (REFACTOR/BUNDLE_FORMAT.md "Stable ids"); absent in a material document's own table, whose layers point by index.

state.description: Resolved; known but not found; or several plausible candidates.

identity.description: Identity of the texture: the resolved one, or the one that was looked for.

payload.description: The texture's data, when it was exported.

unresolved_reason.description: Why a known texture was not found.

candidates.description: Plausible textures when the reference is ambiguous.

texture_id.description: A texture: the id of an entry of the document's resources.textures, where each texture is listed once.

liquid_type.description: A liquid type a document's liquids name; without the liquid DB2s only its identity is known.

identity.description: The LiquidType row, named from its Name; each liquid's liquid_type equals one entry's identity.

vertex_format.description: The vertex layout the material states (0 height+depth, 1 height+uv, 2 depth, 3 height+uv+depth). Ocean (LiquidType 2) instances store depth only whatever this says, so a liquid's own arrays are what it holds.

textures.description: The type's texture slots (LiquidTypeXTexture rows, by OrderIndex), each sized by LiquidType FrameCountTexture. Which slot a shader samples for what depends on the material and is not resolved.

frames.description: The slot's frames in animation order; one frame for a still texture.

kind.description: LiquidTypeXTexture.Type as stored: -1 a file, 0 to 2 a texture the client generates (no file).

waves.description: The FFT ocean-wave spectra the type animates its surface with (the FFTTile rows LiquidTypeXFFTTile links to it, in link ID order); optional, absent when the source has none (every source before WoW Forever 1.60.1 / 12.1.7).

items.description: One spectrum. Its fields are not named by any public definition yet, so they are carried raw.

field_0.description: FFTTile field 0 as stored (16 to 512 seen; likely the FFT grid size).

values.description: FFTTile fields 1 to 9 as stored, f32 (Field_1_60_1_69876_001 to _009); units unverified.

instance_ref.description: One instance of an owned placement set, by its stable id rather than its position.

id.description: The instance's id in that set.

input_kind.description: The shape of an effect input's value. The kind says what the value is, never how a consumer stores it.

input_spec.description: One input an effect or material declares: its kind, and what an instance must supply for it.

description.description: What the input means to the effect.

unit.description: Unit of a number or vector value.

options.description: The values a choice may take.

clock.description: What a curve is keyed by: time within an animation, normalized particle age, or time of day.

optional.description: An instance may leave the input out; absent means not stated.

default.description: The value an instance that leaves the input out gets.

binding.description: A field whose value comes from the instance: an input by name, or a field of the element a for_each source repeats over.

oneOf.description: A field of the current for_each element.

each.description: Field name in the element record.

bound_number.description: A number, or a binding to one.

bound_integer.description: An integer, or a binding to one.

bound_image.description: An image, or a binding to one.

bound_mesh.description: A model, or a binding to one.

tree_box.description: One box of a box tree.

children.description: The boxes it splits into, by index in the tree; none for a leaf.

complete.description: True: the children partition it. False: they may share leaves, so it is a union of overlapping pieces.

bound_vec3.description: Three numbers, or a binding to them.

region.description: Where an effect source applies, relative to its instance; every region may fade over a soft edge.

oneOf.description: Everywhere the instance's anchor reaches: the whole model, or the whole map.
A point: where the source is, its extent stated by its content or style.
A sphere: full strength inside inner_radius, fading out to outer_radius.

outer_radius.description: Radius where it has faded out.

edge.description: Width of a soft fade beyond the radii; absent: none stated.

oneOf.description: An axis-aligned box in the instance's frame.

edge.description: Width of the fade in from the faces; absent: none stated.

oneOf.description: The inside of a model's mesh, in the instance's frame.

model.description: The model whose mesh bounds the region.

oneOf.description: A box refined by a tree of boxes inside it: the root (the box no other lists as a child) is the whole, the leaves its pieces.

boxes.description: The tree's boxes, or a binding to them.

oneOf.description: A convex volume: inside where dot(normal, p) <= distance holds for every plane.

planes.description: The bounding planes, or a binding to them.

edge.description: Width of the fade in from the faces; absent: none stated.

plane.description: A plane with an outward unit normal.

distance.description: Signed distance of the plane from the origin along its normal.

effect_source.description: One part of an effect: where it applies and what it puts in the world.

id.description: Unique within the effect; an instance's style is keyed by it.

parent.description: Id of the source this one lives in or spawns from.

for_each.description: A list input: the source repeats once per element, and each-bindings read the element.

region.description: Where it applies; absent: the parent's region, or everywhere for a source without one.

content.description: What it puts in the world; absent: nothing beyond its style.

effect_content.description: What an effect source puts in the world.

oneOf.description: A participating medium: what light passing through it loses and scatters.

extinction.description: Fraction of light lost per unit length.

albedo.description: Share of the lost light scattered rather than absorbed, linear RGB.

hold.description: How a simulation treats the stated values: pinned exactly, relaxed back toward as a base, or only started from as a seed.

spawn.description: How many particles the source holds; absent: not stated.

density.description: Particles per unit volume of the region.

light.description: How a particle meets light; absent: not stated.

role.description: Emission: it adds its colour as light. Albedo: it reflects the light reaching it.

oneOf.description: A camera-facing textured quad, its texture an atlas of animation frames.

frames.description: Frames the animation plays, from the first tile; may be fewer than the tiles.

extra_layers.description: Further textures layered over the first, in order; absent: one layer.

oneOf.description: A ribbon: a strip trailing behind the source, textured along its length.

extra_layers.description: Further textures layered over the first, in order; absent: one layer.

oneOf.description: A model drawn at each particle, oriented by the particle; it doesn't collide.

linear_fog.description: Fog that thickens linearly with distance from the viewer: one layer (fog or underwater) of a WMO MFOG record.

start.description: Distance where fog begins: the layer's end times its start scalar (mfog_start_scalar_to_start). The source stores the start only as that fraction of the end (wowdev.wiki's MoP fog).

color.description: Fog colour, alpha dropped (0xFF in every sampled record; any other value goes to unresolved).

distance_fog.description: The classic client's fog over view distance, in the blocks a source states; an absent block inherits from the enclosing fog.

style_block.description: How the classic client drew one effect source.

distance_fog.description: Fog over view distance inside the source's region.

exit_blend.description: The source draws nothing but scales the enclosing fog down near the model's exits (MFOG flag 0x1, wowdev.wiki's F_IEBLEND).

looks.description: Alternative looks the client switched to under a viewer condition.

underwater.description: The fog while the viewer is under water.

ambient_color.description: The ambient colour the source overrides inside its region.

colors.description: The source's three colours in order (a WMO MAVG, MAVD or MBVD record's); which one the client uses is unverified.

volumetric_fog.description: The classic client's volumetric fog pass inside the source's region (one VFOG record of the map's _fogs.wdt).

min_quality.description: Drawn when the viewer's fog quality setting is at least this, 0..2.

particulate.description: The classic ambient particle system's own settings: a particulate volume record (WMO MPVD, or the map's _mpv.wdt PVMI).

max_particles.description: Most particles the client simulates at once. The shader bounds its simulation threads by it.

draw.description: How the classic client drew the source's particles: one emitter of a particulate volume record (WMO MPVD, or the map's _mpv.wdt PVMI).

blend.description: How a particle combines with what is already drawn.

particle_system.description: The classic particle system an M2 emitter ran.

ribbon_system.description: The classic ribbon an M2 emitter drew.

zone_light.description: The classic zone light: the light condition the client uses under each condition the zone states (wowdev.wiki DB/Light), from Light LightParamsID.

style.description: The classic look of an effect instance, by the effect's source id; a source repeated per list element has one look per element.

unresolved_field.description: A source value carried before its meaning is known.

field.description: Which source field, in the source's own terms.

kind.description: What class of value it is, as far as the data shows; words are a byte range's raw dwords.

value.description: The value as stored: a number, an array of numbers, a hex string for bits, or an array of hex strings for words.

candidate_role.description: A typed field husk proposes for the value, not yet confirmed. A candidate that corpus evidence or the client shaders confirm is promoted to its typed key (REFACTOR/EFFECTS.md "Unknown data: the evidence ladder").

unresolved.description: Source values whose meaning is not known yet; a consumer never needs them to draw.

ribbon_system.description: The classic ribbon simulation's settings and curves: one M2Ribbon record.

materials.description: Render settings per texture: the M2Material records the ribbon's material indices name.

texture_transform_lookup_index.description: Unresolved index into the source's texture transform lookup.

particle_system.description: The classic particle simulation's settings and curves: one M2Particle record, its tracks keyed in the model file or the sequence's .anim sidecar.

child_emitters_model.description: Model whose emitters each particle carries.

multi_texture_scale.description: Scale of the extra texture layers.

color.description: Colour over the particle's life, [r, g, b], 0..255 observed (not scaled to 0..1).

multi_texture_scroll_mid.description: Scroll midpoints of the extra layers.

multi_texture_scroll_range.description: Scroll ranges of the extra layers.

gravity.description: Gravity: the acceleration vector applied to each particle, in the emitter's frame (the model's axes, z up), rotating with the emitter (its bone and the model's placement), not fixed to world down; decoded from the M2 track's keys by m2_gravity_to_vector (a scalar g becomes [0, 0, -g]; a key with no direction, packed x^2 + y^2 > 128^2, is dropped with a warning and the curve interpolates across it). The emitter frame is game knowledge, not measured from client code; a bad key is dropped rather than failing the export so one emitter can't cost the whole model.

priority.description: What a renderer thins first within its budget: decorative, then ambient; essential stays.

provenance_fields.description: How an instance's values were obtained, by path within the instance ("inputs.extinction", "priority"); a path not listed was read from the source. A consumer switches a rule off by ignoring the fields it produced (REFACTOR/EFFECTS.md "Provenance").

kind.description: Computed by husk by a named rule, or written by a person.

rule.description: The derivation rule's name (REFACTOR/EFFECTS.md); a consumer can ignore everything one rule produced.

zone_fog_values.description: A light parameter set's fog at one time of day, named after the source table's (LightData) columns. Their roles in the fog record are candidates (REFACTOR/EFFECTS.md), so the names stay close to the source's.

density.description: The client's exponential-fog parameter, not an extinction. The shader fogs by exp(-e * k), e the yards past the fog start; how the client turns this value into k is not known (REFACTOR/EFFECTS.md, fog_density_to_extinction).

height_density.description: The client's exponential-fog parameter inside the height fog, not an extinction. Its transform is unknown, as for density.

sun_angle.description: Cosine past which sun fog starts.

end_color_distance.description: Distance of the end fog colour.

height_coefficients.description: Height-fog cubic coefficients x^3, x^2, x, 1.

main_coefficients.description: Main-fog cubic coefficients x^3, x^2, x, 1.

height_density_coefficients.description: Height-density cubic coefficients x^3, x^2, x, 1.

geoset.description: A geoset: a group of alternative mesh ranges (customization choices and gear pick among them) and the variant within it.

light_condition_id.description: A light condition: the id of an entry of the document's resources.light_conditions, where each is listed once.

light_key.description: A light parameter set's values at one time of day (one LightData row), each colour unpacked from the stored 0x00RRGGBB to 0..1 with no gamma conversion. A colour's nonzero high byte (alpha or flags, unverified) is under unresolved, since its meaning is not known.

time.description: Time of day the values hold at, converted from the stored half-minutes; between two keys the client interpolates.

shadow_opacity.description: Shadow opacity, stored as a colour (grey on 19,526 of 12.1.0's 19,866 rows).

sky.description: The procedural sky's colour bands, top to horizon.

layer1_ambient_color.description: Ambient colour of the first layer.

layer2_ambient_color.description: Ambient colour of the second layer.

water.description: Water colours near and far from the viewer.

color_grading.description: A 1024x32 lookup texture remapping the frame's colours (wowdev.wiki DB/LightData), the texture of LightData ColorGradingFileDataID; absent: none.

darker_color_grading.description: The darker variant of color_grading, the texture of LightData DarkerColorGradingFileDataID; absent: none.

unresolved.description: Source values with no field yet.

light_settings.description: A light parameter set's settings that don't change with time (one LightParams row).

skybox.description: The sky model drawn (the LightSkybox row LightParams LightSkyboxID names).

ref.description: The LightSkybox row, named from LightSkybox.Name: the sky model's pre-FileDataID path (e.g. "ENVIRONMENTS\Stars\DeathSkybox.mdx"), the only name the client gives a sky.

celestial_model.description: A second sky model, for celestial bodies.

flags.description: LightSkybox Flags as stored (names in wowdev.wiki DB/LightSkybox).

glow.description: How much fog is added to everything (wowdev.wiki DB/LightParams).

water_alpha.description: Water opacity at shallow and deep points.

sun.description: Where the sun stands and how its light fades; all 0 means the client's default.

polar.description: The sun's polar angle, converted as if stored in degrees (an inference from the values; unconfirmed).

azimuth.description: The sun's azimuth, converted as if stored in degrees (an inference from the values; unconfirmed).

hide_sun.description: The sun is not drawn (flag 0x4). Of wowdev.wiki's two name lists for these flags, only bits 0x4, 0x8 and 0x10 agree, so only they are named.

flags.description: LightParams Flags as stored (names in wowdev.wiki DB/LightParams).

celestial_sphere_override.description: The celestial sphere override as stored; absent when stored zero.

sun_position_override.description: The sun position override as stored; absent when stored zero.

unresolved.description: Source values with no field yet.

light_condition.description: A light condition: what a zone light shows under one condition (a LightParams row).

id.description: This condition's stable id, derived from its LightParams row (REFACTOR/BUNDLE_FORMAT.md "Stable ids"); zone lights name it by this id.

settings.description: Absent when the build's LightParams file has no row for this id, though LightData keys it.

keys.description: The values by time of day, ascending.

framebuffer_blend.description: How the drawn colour combines with the framebuffer, per the client's EGxBlend states; each value's formula is the technique document framebuffer_blend/<value> the material references.

surface_type.description: What a surface is made of (a TerrainType row: Dirt, Grass, Stone, Snow...). The client picks footstep sounds and sprays by it; a renderer or weather system can ask the same question.

ref.description: The TerrainType row; its name is the row's TerrainDesc.

sound_class.description: The TerrainTypeSounds row footsteps play, named from its Name; absent when the build has no TerrainType row for ref.

flags.description: TerrainType Flags as stored (wowdev.wiki DB/TerrainType: 0x1 footprints).

surface_type_index.description: A surface: index into the document's resources.surface_types, where each is listed once.
